geo.title: Get started

Measure a hallway map; what does "between" really mean?

Goal: I can use the Ruler Postulate and segment addition.

slides.title: The big idea
slides.html:
Ruler Postulate: the points of a line can be matched one to one with the real numbers, so the distance between two points is the absolute value of the difference of their coordinates.

If A is at 2 and B is at 9, then AB = |9 − 2| = 7. Point B is between A and C when all three are collinear and AB + BC = AC. That is the Segment Addition Postulate. If AB = 7 and BC = 5 with B between A and C, then AC = 12.
